raised: Can't tell which product or track their own money is in now
Nothing on the page says 'קרן חדשה מקיפה' means pension
Can't tell whether 0.16% of savings plus 1.47% of deposits costs more or less than a flat 0.5%, or which of 'מההפקדה' and 'מהחיסכון' costs more
'123 מקור / 123 מחושב' was confusing and its purpose unclear
Product names (קרן חדשה מקיפה/כללית, תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים, מרכזית לפיצויים) meant nothing, including the difference between מקיפה and כללית
The same S&P 500 index shows different returns in different products
Worried that extra costs not shown mean the displayed fee isn't the full cost
Terms on the קרנות סל/מחקות cards (4A/4D, צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, נאמן, משתנים/קבועים, the tax line) not understood
No return column for קרנות סל/מחקות, so they can't be compared
Unclear whether savings can even be moved into a קרן סל/מחקה
Titles in the 'מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל' list don't say what's inside
The ring and dot percentages (99% מניות and 99% מט"ח) don't add up to 100, so they gave up on them
'עוד לא דווח' unclear beyond the footnote
No way to see what the fee means in shekels for a typical deposit
Couldn't find whether a lower fee can be negotiated
Couldn't find how to switch tracks or whether that costs anything or triggers tax
No one-line note on whether S&P 500 is risky for a young person
No comparison of Harel's fees against other companies
Would drop irrelevant sections: מרכזית לפיצויים, חיסכון לכל ילד, the age 50/60 rows, תגמולים, the documents list and the rings
Would drop the קופה number column and the tracks with less than 3 years of history

problems.why: The reader can't work out what the fee column's two figures (from savings vs from deposits) mean in cost terms, which is a clear part of the person's complaint that the fee column isn't explained.
